item.title: Apache Zeppelin vs Polynote vs JupyterLab: Best Self-Hosted Data Notebooks 2026
item.description: Data analysts, scientists, and engineers need interactive environments where they can write code, run queries, visualize results, and share findings — all in a single document. Self-hosted notebook platforms provide this capability while keeping your data and code within your own infrastructure.
